question: Which of the following Amendments clarified that the President must act in accordance with the advice of the Council of Ministers?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**42nd Amendment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **42nd Amendment** of the Indian Constitution was enacted in **1976** during the Emergency period under the leadership of then Prime Minister **Indira Gandhi.**
 
• This amendment is often referred to as the **"Mini Constitution"** due to the significant changes it brought to the Constitution.
